formDescription: Multi-file upload widget. Users click Add files to choose one or more files, optionally enter a per-file Description after files are queued, and click Start upload to upload the queue. Empty queue state displays Drag files here, Start upload is disabled, total status is 0%, and size is 0 b. Queued file state shows rows with Filename, Status, Size, and a dynamic Description input; the footer can show text like Uploaded 0/1 files.

AddFiles.title: Add files
AddFiles.description: Button that opens the file picker to add one or more files to the upload queue.

StartUpload.title: Start upload
StartUpload.description: Button that starts uploading queued files. It may be disabled when no files are queued.

p1juinteh9bbn9hkvbf4cr1dn00_html5.title: HTML5 file input
p1juinteh9bbn9hkvbf4cr1dn00_html5.description: Underlying file input used by the widget to select multiple files.

Description_p1juio06vo156t15k84m9105n15d.title: Description
Description_p1juio06vo156t15k84m9105n15d.description: Dynamic per-file Description input shown after a file is queued. The data-id includes the generated queued-file id and changes per file.
